title: Did You Love Somebody
lyrics:
[00:19.81] In your voice, so soft and low
[00:24.50] Did you wake your loves that've come before?
[00:29.62] Did you bring all those songs you sing?
[00:34.69] Or have I been sung only songs for me?
[00:40.86] Did you love somebody only just
[00:45.23] For the rush, like me?
[00:49.83] Did you fear the hand you hold had let go?
[00:57.05] Right as you finish saying
[01:02.40] Don't you go all silent too
[01:06.91] Just let me chew
[01:09.04] On all the things that you wanna tell me
[01:12.71] I've heard whisper on a wing
[01:16.94] Let silence sting
[01:19.42] So, go on say what you wanna sell me
[01:32.77] In the moments on your own
[01:36.81] Did you beg that love would take you home?
[01:42.23] Did you see how your love could be
[01:46.92] And decide to hell, that's enough for me?
[01:52.53] Did you love somebody for to make
[01:57.82] Your mistake, your fool?
